findings.quote: if (stated !== null && Number(stated[1]) >= unverified.length) return ok(
findings.problem: The readiness item `verifier` passes unverified blocker/major findings when report.md, a file the reviewing agent writes, contains `Not verified: N` with N at least the unverified count. No operator act is involved, so on a host without operator cards the agent alone satisfies the gate.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat the unverified state as a readiness waiver that needs an operator card or a TTY, instead of accepting the report line.

findings.problem: The moved-head / merged-PR gate of `review complete` passes when the first line of report.md names the reviewed SHA and says the PR moved. The agent writes that line, so the agent alone can close a round whose PR moved or merged.
findings.suggested_fix: Require an operator waiver (card or TTY) to close a round on a moved or merged head.

findings.problem: `review complete --head <sha>` replaces the reviewed head recorded at `review start` with any 7-40 hex string, with only a warning. Passing the PR's current head makes the moved-head check in complete-head-gate.ts report no movement.
findings.suggested_fix: Accept --head only when it equals the recorded head or is an ancestor of it; refuse otherwise, naming both SHAs.

findings.quote: const researchProblems = waivedRadius ? [] : await packageResearchErrors(packageDir, manifest.artifacts, researchFindings);
findings.problem: A readiness waiver of any one of files-covered, blast-radius, reviewers or ledger empties the whole research-error list. The comment above says the waiver replaces the refusal 'for it', but every research error is dropped, including ones unrelated to the waived item.
findings.suggested_fix: Filter research errors by the item each belongs to and drop only those of waived items.

findings.problem: publishReview recomputes readiness but never runs the gates that live only on the complete path: the round-record tamper check (managed.ts:1039) and the evidence-level check (managed.ts:1075-1082). A package that `review complete` refuses can still be posted to GitHub.
findings.suggested_fix: One shared gate evaluation used by both complete and publish.

findings.quote: reported provenance, not a cryptographic attestation
findings.problem: An operator decision recorded through the host's own question tool (confirmedVia host-question) is the model's report of the operator's answer, yet the published review body does not tell readers that keryx did not verify it.
findings.suggested_fix: State in the published body which decisions were recorded via host-question and that keryx did not verify them.

findings.quote: On `spawn_subagent` pass its tier as `model_tier` on every reviewer
findings.problem: The orchestrator skill tells keryx shell to pass `model_tier` (light|standard|deep) on reviewer dispatches. spawn_subagent ignores model_tier (src/harness/tool/builtin/spawn-subagent-tool.ts:1497-1498) and accepts model_class (light|standard|expert|frontier), which no review skill names. Every reviewer therefore runs on the routing default, not on the tier `keryx review tier` computed.
findings.suggested_fix: Switch the skill to model_class with a tier mapping and add a contract test that fails when a review skill names a spawn field the tool ignores.
